# We One Aviation Academy — LLM Index

> DGCA-approved pilot training academy in Dwarka, New Delhi, India. Operating since 2009. 3500+ pilots trained, 98% success rate, international flight-training tie-ups in USA, Canada, Australia, UK, and South Africa.

## Courses
- [Commercial Pilot License (CPL) — Complete Guide](https://weoneaviation.in/commercial-pilot-license): CPL in India — eligibility, process, flying-hour requirements, and career path.
- [DGCA Ground Classes](https://weoneaviation.in/dgca-ground-classes): DGCA ground school — key subjects, eligibility, class structure, and exam preparation.
- [CPL Flight Training](https://weoneaviation.in/courses/cpl-flight-training): Detailed CPL training path — syllabus phases, medical/exam steps, and fee components.
- [ATPL Training](https://weoneaviation.in/courses/atpl): ATPL preparation — advanced airline-level subjects, simulator-focused training, captain-track progression.
- [CPL Program](https://weoneaviation.in/courses/cpl): DGCA-approved CPL program — duration, eligibility, and core syllabus coverage.

## Flying schools by country
- [Flying School — India](https://weoneaviation.in/flying-school/india): India-focused CPL-MEIR training route with DGCA alignment, stages, and timeline.
- [Flying School — USA](https://weoneaviation.in/flying-school/usa): FAA-track training overview — pathway from PPL to CPL and hour-building guidance.
- [Flying School — Canada](https://weoneaviation.in/flying-school/canada): Canada training route, mapped to the pilot training programs template and summary.
- [Flying School — Australia](https://weoneaviation.in/flying-school/australia): CASA-accredited Australia route — CPL/MEIR pathway, visa context, DGCA conversion notes.
- [Flying School — South Africa](https://weoneaviation.in/flying-school/south-africa): SACAA-based South Africa CPL pathway with staged training flow and DGCA conversion.

## How to become a pilot
- [How to Become a Pilot After 12th](https://weoneaviation.in/how-to-become-a-pilot-after-12th): Step-by-step guide for becoming a pilot after Class 12 — DGCA medical, exams, training flow.
- [Pilot After 12th — Roadmap](https://weoneaviation.in/how-to-become-a-pilot/after-12th): Structured roadmap for students after 12th — eligibility, hours, and cost overview.
- [How to Become a Pilot in India](https://weoneaviation.in/how-to-become-a-pilot/in-india): India-specific CPL guide — DGCA requirements, training routes, salary progression.

## DGCA subject guides
- [Air Navigation](https://weoneaviation.in/air-navigation): DGCA CPL/PPL Air Navigation guide — flight-planning and navigation-system fundamentals.
- [Air Regulations](https://weoneaviation.in/air-regulations): Air Regulations guide — ICAO, DGCA frameworks, rules of the air, licensing/compliance.
- [Aviation Meteorology](https://weoneaviation.in/aviation-meteorology): Aviation Meteorology guide — weather concepts, METAR/TAF literacy, flight-safety decisions.
- [Technical General](https://weoneaviation.in/technical-general): Technical General guide — aircraft systems, aerodynamics, engines, core pilot technical knowledge.
- [RTR (Aero)](https://weoneaviation.in/rtr-a): RTR (Aero) guide for aviation radio communication licensing and exam preparation.
